subject: general
question: Which state inaugurated "One Family One Job Scheme" in Jan, 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The "One Family One Job" scheme was inaugurated by the state government of **Sikkim** in January 2019.
 
• This scheme aims to provide employment to one member of each family who does not have a government job.
 
• The initiative was launched by the then Chief Minister of Sikkim, **Pawan Kumar Chamling**.
 
• Under this scheme, around 20,000 youths were initially given appointment letters for various jobs in different departments of the state government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **One Family One Job Scheme:**

 
 
• The scheme was introduced to tackle unemployment in the state of Sikkim by ensuring that at least one member from each family secures a government job.
 
• The scheme targets families where no one has a government job and aims to reduce the economic disparity by providing steady employment.
 
• The scheme was part of a broader initiative to uplift the socio-economic status of the residents of Sikkim.
 
• This job scheme is considered a significant move towards inclusive growth and development in the state.
 
 
 
• **Employment Schemes in India:**
 
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA):**
 
 
• MGNREGA is an Indian labor law and social security measure that aims to guarantee the 'right to work'.
 
• It aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
 
 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY):**
 
 
• PMKVY is a flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE) implemented by National Skill Development Corporation.
 
• The objective of this scheme is to enable a large number of Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that will help them in securing a better livelihood.
 
 
 
• **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY):**
 
 
• DDU-GKY is a placement-linked skill training initiative of the Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD), Government of India.
 
• The scheme aims to transform rural poor youth into an economically independent and globally relevant workforce.
